name: markstream-vue
title_zh: 把 Markdown 流式渲染接进 Vue 3 的官
tagline_zh: Codex 要往 Vue 3 里加流式 Markdown？CSS 顺序、渲染器、虚拟滚动、长 AI 输出——这份 。
tagline_en: Adding streaming Markdown to Vue 3? CSS order, renderer choice, virtual scrolling, long AI output—this skill.
desc_en: Integrate markstream-vue into a Vue 3 app. Use when Codex needs to add the Vue 3 renderer, import CSS in the right order, choose renderer and DOM modes, choose built-in, plain, or custom code-block paths, choose between `content` and `nodes`, coordinate long AI timelines with `MarkstreamVirtualTimeline`, `useMarkstreamVirtualAdapter`, or `vue-virtual-scroller`, enable optional peers such as stream
why_zh: 它把散落在文档各处的集成决策（渲染器/DOM 模式/数据源/虚拟时间线）收拢成一份带上下文的行动清单。
why_en: It consolidates scattered integration decisions (renderer/DOM mode/data source/virtual timeline) into one context-aware.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 markstream-vue 的接入与配置，不含业务组件设计；需要你已有 Vue 3 项目与 npm 环境。
limit_en: Only covers markstream-vue integration/config, not your business components. Requires an existing Vue 3 project + npm. Steps on virtual scrolling.
